How an engagement works

Four steps. No surprises.

  1. Conversation

    A 30-minute call to understand where things get stuck and whether I’m the right fit.

  2. Map

    I walk through the process with the people who run it and pinpoint the handovers that break.

  3. Fix

    We design and put in place the changes together: workflows, data rules, templates, tooling.

  4. Hand over

    Documentation and training so the improvement keeps working after I step back.

Who I work with

  • SMBs and scale-ups whose processes haven’t kept up with growth
  • Startups that need operational structure before they scale
  • Teams in the startup and incubator ecosystem around Oslo

Let’s find where your handovers get lost.

A 30-minute conversation about your process. You leave with a clearer picture, whether we work together or not.
